design_rationale:
WHY A GOOD TEST. Genevieve Hollister only asks to sign the remediation agreement for her scheduled Extensive job and pay "whatever deposit" keeps the 2026-10-26 start. The scored number is the signing deposit (2702.96). The deposit rule fixes it only after the job's charge lines carry two owed pre-signing lines that the records show missing: the pre-removal asbestos sampling (1948 building) and the supervisor work-plan visit (Extensive requires a protocol). Each is itself a 6-factor computation reading the linked water job (W0), the linked claim file (CF0) and the job dates. Difficulty = discovering the two lines from the deposit rule's prerequisite sentences + reconciling water/claim records + three layered computations; one tool per problem.

SCOPE. Task 0 claims mold_ext_presample_line, mold_ext_workplan_line, mold_ext_signing_deposit and tools book_mold_presample_d4275783, book_mold_workplan_1501986a, sign_mold_agreement_2b99f603 (owner=user). Task 1 holds mold_ext_disposal_line and mold_ext_insured_share; scopes are disjoint and cover all five policies.

DRAW (draw_counts.py --task 0): prerequisite_problems=2, factor_counts=[6,6,5] -> presample 6, workplan 6, deposit 5.

PROBLEM-TREE CARD. Root mold_ext_signing_deposit (user). Edge A: deposit -> presample, value_input, gate booked_charges, form state, sentence "The signing deposit is fixed only after the job's charge lines carry the pre-removal asbestos sampling owed on a building built before the asbestos sampling year cutoff." (affirmative); resolved_by book_mold_presample_d4275783 (agent); false at opening: mold_jobs.J0.year_built=1948 and J0 carries no charge line (balance_due 0.0; every seeded mold charge belongs to the closed 2025 job at the customer's other property). Edge B: deposit -> workplan, value_input, gate booked_charges, form state, sentence "The signing deposit is not worked out until the job's charge lines carry the work-plan visit owed on a tier that requires a protocol." (negated); resolved_by book_mold_workplan_1501986a (agent); false at opening: J0 is Extensive (protocol_required true) with no supervisor_labor line. Only the presample policy books an asbestos_sampling line on a scheduled job and only the workplan policy books the work-plan supervisor_labor line. Topological order: presample, workplan (they commute: neither reads mold charges), then signing. Deletion sensitivity: skip presample -> deposit 2252.96; skip workplan -> 1995.00. user_scenario names neither line; the tools validate formats only.

BASE-INVARIANT CARD. Signing (mold_authorization): au_state - J0.status=scheduled; protocol - protocol_date 2026-10-12 (assessor visit one week after the 2026-10-05 loss) is on or before the signing date 2026-10-23, assessor Harrowgate Environmental Consulting on file. Payment (mold_customer_payment): py_state - J0 not closed. Sampling/work-plan lines (mold_remediation_charge): sc_state retired by each policy's declared overwrite; no_reclean_billing - J0 has no failed clearance. J0 is insurance_claim (not company_warranty), so both lines are owed. No time-kind gate applies.

BUSINESS-OBJECT CARD. Object = J0 (Extensive, scheduled). Distractor: closed 2025 Spot job JP at 77 Laurel Glen Court, Mandeville (single_family 1995; its 5 lines and 2 payments are excluded by mold_job_id). Water evidence keyed water_job_id=J0.water_job_id; claim evidence keyed claim_file_id=J0.claim_file_id. No other mold job is linked to CF0, so the shared-sublimit referral does not apply.

FACTOR CARD (handling-time values; result with that factor at baseline in brackets).
presample 450.00 [all-baseline 595.00]: prior_results results review 85.00 (water sampling 2026-10-06, 15 days before the opened date) [960.00]; building_age_set 145.00 (age 78, living_area) [305.00]; lab_turnaround expedite 95.00 (lead 5 days) [355.00]; documentation_set 110.00 (public adjuster Gulfside Claim Advocates) [340.00]; contaminated_handling 90.00 (category_3) [360.00]; water_crew_collection -75.00 (drying under way on the opened date) [525.00]. The lowest standard-set tier (85.00) exceeds the largest credit (75.00), so the line is always above 0.00.
workplan 707.96 [all-baseline 195.30]: water_footprint_walk 4.0 h (affected 420 sq ft: 300 / 100 sq ft per hour = 3.0 plus two 100 sq ft steps x 0.5) [512.66]; claim_coordination 0.5 h [659.14]; regulated_planning 1.0 h (water lead line 2026-10-07) [610.31]; moisture_verification 0.5 h [659.14]; plan_lead_time 0.25 h [683.55]; overhead_survey 1.0 h (class_3) [610.31]; 7.25 h x 97.65 = 707.9625.
deposit 2702.96 [all-baseline 2657.96]: coverage_credit_tier 1000.00 [3702.96]; notice_raise_tier 100.00 (3 days) [2602.96]; lead_prepayment 395.00 [2307.96]; contamination_raise_tier 250.00 [2452.96]; payment_route_raise 300.00 (public adjuster) [2402.96]; booked 1157.96.
Multi-source (distinct records in every non-fall-through tier): lead_prepayment (water lines + mold job), prior_results (water line date vs job opened date), water_crew_collection, regulated_planning and moisture_verification (water records vs the job's opened date). Cross-difficulty: water and claims.
Near-misses: lead time 5 sits on the expedite / short-plan / short-notice upper boundaries; the water asbestos line would select asbestos planning but the lead line ranks first.

SEED. Customer (profile opened 2025-05-12 with the Spot job), J0, JP history; W0 Black Water Standard Loss, opened 2026-10-06, drying since 2026-10-07, affected 420 sq ft, with service call 259.00, asbestos sampling 425.00 (2026-10-06, before the flood cut), lead-safe setup 345.00, flood cut 64 lf x 3.40 = 217.60, antimicrobial 420 sq ft x 0.41 = 172.20 (balance 1418.80); CF0 Public Adjuster Coordinated, approved 2026-10-15 with its initial approval row 6840.00, unpaid, mold sublimit 1000.00.

PERSONA. Tired, organized retiree; volunteers only the goal and the start date; phone + ZIP on request, email only if a third detail is needed; insurance details only if asked; passive "go ahead" if told something must be added first; runs the signing/payment step herself by debit card and reads back the confirmation; ends after it.

STANDARD SOLUTION. find_customers -> verify (phone, ZIP) -> find_mold_jobs -> find_mold_charges/payments (customer) -> find_water_jobs, find_water_charges (W0) -> find_claims_files, find_claims_approvals (CF0) -> book sampling 450.00 dated 2026-10-21 -> book work plan 707.96 dated 2026-10-21 -> hand over signing: deposit 2702.96, debit_card.

VERIFICATION (actual runs). check_compute: COMPUTE OK (expected, every factor_sensitivity and baseline_result recomputed). Opening-world deposit without the two lines: 1545.00. Probe on scratch copies: a cancelled water job, a withdrawn claim file and a foreign write-off of the same customer leave all three values unchanged; with both links absent the opening-world values are presample 835.00, workplan 219.71, deposit 1735.00; a company_warranty job gives 0.00 on all three (no lines, no deposit).
user_scenario: You are Genevieve Hollister, a retired school librarian in her late fifties who owns condo unit 3B at 1416 Esplanade Avenue in New Orleans. You sound tired but organized, you keep a little notebook of dates, and you apologize for rambling. A sewer line backed up into your unit in early October, Ridgecrest has had drying equipment running there since, and the mold remediation crew is now scheduled to start on Monday, October 26. You are calling because you want to sign the remediation agreement today and pay whatever deposit Ridgecrest needs from you so that the Monday start stays on the calendar. You do not know what the deposit is and you have no figure in mind; you expect the representative to tell you. When the representative asks who you are, you give your phone number, 5045550217, and your ZIP code, 70116; only if they say they need one more detail do you add your email, genevieve.hollister@bayoumail.net. If they ask about your insurance, you say a public adjuster is handling the claim with Fairhaven Mutual and that the claim number is FMI-HO-26-2417, and you add that you never know what the policy will cover. If the representative explains that something has to be added to your job before the deposit can be worked out, you say that is fine and they should go ahead; you never ask what it is or how much it costs before they tell you. Signing and paying is something you want to do yourself: when the representative hands you the signing and payment step, you complete it in the secure channel with the deposit amount they tell you, paying with your debit card, and you read back the confirmation number it shows you. If the representative asks how you want to pay, you say your debit card. You do not give card numbers over the phone, and if asked you say you would rather enter them yourself. Once you have signed and the payment confirmation has come through, you thank them, say you will see the crew on Monday, and end the call.
